name: compute-squad
description: Compute Squad runs a staged, auditable coding workflow in Claude Code and Codex. Before every run or resume, you choose and confirm exact models for the top, mid, and bottom tiers; the same model can fill several. Agents map, plan, execute, and adversarially review the work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, execute, and adversarially accept code changes — MECHANICAL, STANDARD, or COMPLEX tier routing, for Claude Code and Codex
interface.longDescription: Run a staged Compute Squad workflow in Codex: lock the goal, archive prior run state, map the codebase, produce a no-guesswork plan, execute it at the model tier the PM's MECHANICAL, STANDARD, or COMPLEX classification calls for, and adversarially accept the result through an append-only log. The same pipeline also ships as a native Claude Code plugin.
defaultPrompt: Run Compute Squad on this goal
Map, plan, execute, and accept this code change
